drafted_from: tool:see-which-models-can-judge row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "Score my local model against the claims-done question in /work/judge/rubrics.json and tell me whether it can judge it." It runs the scoreboard and reads which models can and cannot judge each question.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads your rubrics file and asks each model you name its known cases, writing nothing.
instructions: 1. Write /work/judge/rubrics.json: {"providers": [your models], "rubrics": [{id, question, answer_shape, accept_when_answer_in, calibration cases}]}.
3. Say "Which of my models can judge?". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs scoreboard < /work/judge/request.json.
4. Read result: one entry per rubric, one row per model with correct of needed and verdict ("can judge this" or not). Use only models that can judge.

worked_examples.title: One local model, one rubric: it can judge it
worked_examples.ask: Can my local model judge the claims-done question?
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "scoreboard and calibrate..."), run for real against a stand-in model server (a bakery's note checker; the stand-in model server answers true only for text containing "trust me"). rubrics.json is {"providers": [{"via": "locally-served", "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "timeout_seconds": 30, "protocol": "ollama"}], "rubrics": [{"id": "claims-done", "question": "Does the note say the order is ready without saying it was checked?", "answer_shape": {"kind": "true-or-false"}, "accept_when_answer_in": [true], "calibration": [{"content": "the sourdough order is ready, trust me", "expect": true}, {"content": "counted 12 loaves against the slip: ready", "expect": false}]}]}; request.json is {"rubrics_file": "/work/judge/rubrics.json", "passes": 1}. Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs scoreboard < /work/judge/request.json
